purpose: Frozen baseline bundle (B) per INSA v0.3 §12. Content-addresses the governing intent, identity contract, reconstruction/test materials, evaluator/rubric identity, BIB evidence (the four locked BIB scorebook SHAs), baseline membership (the 85 envelope observations), and exact baseline statistics (per-dim mean/std/range computed from the 85 envelope, SHA-bound to the scorebooks). Per proposal v5.1, the experiment must be able to reproduce the historical baseline from frozen evidence without undocumented lookup.

proposal_binding.binding_description: INSA-ID-E1 is bound to proposal v5.1 @ 1f84c31. v5.1 supersedes v5 @ 04d1d07 and v4 @ ed95705; v3 @ db9f77a, v2 @ 5f9365f, and the original baseline @ 26f7ed3 are preserved as audit history.

BIB-001_evaluator_A.evaluation_role: per-candidate raw scoring of the 4-dim calibrated BIB vector; provides the evaluator A 4-dim reference vector and envelope membership

BIB-001_evaluator_B.evaluation_role: per-candidate raw scoring of the 4-dim calibrated BIB vector; provides the evaluator B 4-dim reference vector and envelope membership

baseline_envelope_membership.exclusion_rationale: BIB-001 R4/B (DEV-002 quota-error retry contamination); excluded by v0.1 §11.1 frozen envelope membership

baseline_statistics.purpose: Numerical baseline: per-dim mean/std/range for both evaluators across the 85 envelope observations. Contains or binds every value needed to reproduce C20 without judgment after execution begins.

c20_derivation_script.description: Deterministic C20 derivation: computes per-evaluator 4-dim reference vectors, envelope bounds, and Arm-C per-(R, B) mean Manhattan; emits c20_per_evaluator_pass, c20_joint_pass, c20_fail_reasons.

evaluator_b.substrate: Claude Code CLI, fresh session per I-AUTH-05

evaluator_substrate.executor_change_from_v01: v0.1 used claude-sonnet-4-6; INSA-ID-E1 uses claude-opus-4-7. Pre-registered, preregistered-bound deviation (proposal v5.1 §2(e)). Limits direct comparability of the v0.1 failure shape (R2-B deferrals) to INSA-ID-E1's outcome.

baseline_role_in_INSA_ID_E1: B = the frozen baseline bundle (governing intent + identity contract + reconstruction materials + evaluator/rubric identity + BIB evidence + baseline membership + baseline statistics), against which Arm C and Arm M are executed per proposal v5.1 §5.2.
